turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: Today we will talk about principles and standards of reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: In this module we will explain principles and standards.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: As a start, let us answer two questions.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Umbuzo wokuqala uthi, ziyini izimiso zokufunda?
turns.en: The first question says, what are the principles of reading?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Izimiso zokufunda yindlela okulindeleke ukuthi kufundiswe ngayo ukufunda kulelo nalelo banga emabangeni aphansi.
turns.en: Principles of reading is the way it is expected that reading should be taught in each and every grade in the lower grades.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Umbuzo wesibili uthi, ziyini izilinganiso zokufunda?
turns.en: The second question says, what are the standards of reading?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Izilinganiso zokufunda zingamazinga anobuchule okumele atholakale ezingeni elithile lokufunda.
turns.en: Standards of reading are levels of competence that must be achieved at a certain level of reading.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Njengoba sesichazile izimiso nezilinganiso zokufunda, asiqale i-module ukuze siyibone ukuthi sisebenza kanjani ekilasini.
turns.en: As we have already explained the principles and standards of reading, let us start the module so that we see how it works in the classroom.

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.en: I will be with you on your learning journey.
